content: Isra7eele asay, “Haayite! Ane Godaako simmoos. I nuna mentherethis, shin I nuna koolana; I nuna madunxisis, shin I nu madunthaa qachana.
Nam7u gallasape guye I nuna pathana; heedzantho gallasan nu iya sinthan daana mela nuna denthana.
Ane Godaa eroos; iya eranaw minthidi kaalloos. Xalqey doleysada I qoncana; torche iri yeysada I nuuko yaana” yaagidosona.
Goday, “Ta hintena Efreema asaa waato? Ta hintena Yihuda asaa waato? Hinte siiqoy wonta xaasa mela; ellesidi dhayiya aka mela.
Hessa gisho, taani nabeta baggara hintena qanxerethas; ta doonape keyida qaalan hintena wodhas. Ta pirday hinte bolla poo7oda wagaggi gaana.
Ta yarsho gidonashin maarota koyayis; xuussa yarsho gidonashin Xoossaa ero koyayis.
“Shin enti Addaameda, caaqo menthidosona; yan taw ammanetona ixidosona.
Galada katamay suuthi gukiya iita ooso oothiya asay kumida katama.
Pangati ase wodhanaw qosetidi naageysada kahineta cugay hessada naagoosona. Seekema katamaa efiya ogiyan naagidi ase wodhoosona; enti yeellaya worandzo ooso oothosona.
Taani Isra7eele asaa giddon daganthiyaba be7as. Efreema giddon laymatethi de7ees; Isra7eeley tunis.
“Yihuda, taani ta asaa di7uwa zaariya wode new qassi caka wode giigisas.
